optimization.py.S3a_code_excerpt: schedule(route=True): min ready same-color source by squared distance from previous endpoint to candidate start; no stroke reversal; DAG-ready pool only

study_v02.py.S3a_code_excerpt:
# S3a is deliberately allowed to invert protected cross-color edges; within one
 # color it still retains all same-color dependencies and each source direction.
 s3a=[];base_edges=baseline_graph['edges']
 for c in sorted(set(colors.values()),key=lambda c:(-bright[c],c)):
  nodes=[i for i in colors if colors[i]==c]
  local,_=schedule(nodes,base_edges,colors,bright,starts,ends,'bright',route=True)
  s3a+=local
 plans['S3a']=list(range(N_INK))+s3a

S3a_routing.color_routing: directed nearest-ready endpoint/start heuristic inside each color batch; not merely grouping; not globally optimal
